nodes.name: Start
nodes.notes: Input your 280 time entry items here

parameters.bodyParametersJson:
={
  "model": "gpt-3.5-turbo",
  "messages": [
    {
      "role": "system",
      "content": "You are an expert categorization specialist. Your task is to receive a brief note and classify it into EXACTLY ONE of the predefined categories.

CATEGORIZATION RULES:
- Conference names (NASDDDS, SNP Alliance, Milken Summit, MLTSS Summit, etc.) = 'Travel and Events'
- Meetings with people/organizations = 'Meetings and Collaboration'
- Research, reading reports, policy analysis = 'Policy and Research'
- Director calls, policy updates = 'Meetings and Collaboration'
- Webinars (attended or presented) = 'Training, Webinars, and Presentations'
- Office hours with states = 'Technical Assistance to States'
- Website work, aging website updates = 'Communications and Outreach'
- Survey development, data collection = 'Project Work and Deliverables'
- Hill visits, advocacy = 'Communications and Outreach'
- Timesheets, admin tasks = 'Administrative and Operational Tasks'
- Empty or unclear notes = 'No Comments / Not Specified'

VALID CATEGORIES:
Meetings and Collaboration
Project Work and Deliverables
Administrative and Operational Tasks
Financial and Invoicing
Training, Webinars, and Presentations
Travel and Events
Technical Assistance to States
Communications and Outreach
Policy and Research
No Comments / Not Specified

Return ONLY valid JSON:
{
  "category": "<exact category name>",
  "hours": <hours_value>
}"
    },
    {
      "role": "user",
      "content": "Note: {{ $json.notes_original }}

States mentioned: {{ $json.states }}

Hours: {{ $json.Hours }}"
    }
  ],
  "temperature": 0.2,
  "response_format": { "type": "json_object" }
}

nodes.name: OpenAI Categorize
nodes.notes: Processes items with 200ms delay between requests to avoid rate limits

nodes.name: Parse & Format Results
nodes.notes: Extracts categorization results and formats output
